description: Opens a local multiuser session (a .alsNN file on the serve host, for example the projectFile of tia_server_project_sessions) in the TIA Portal of the serve. The portal MUST hold NO open project and no other session: start it without a project (tia_start, not tia_connect). Do NOT call tia_connect first: it opens a project, and an open project is refused with 409 project_open (details.openProjects). No portal running is 409 not_connected: start one with tia_start, never with tia_connect. A different session already open is 409 session_open (details.openSessions); nothing is ever closed to make room. The same session already open is an idempotent success (alreadyOpen:true). A missing file is 404 not_found; a folder, a file that is not .alsNN or a malformed path is 400 bad_request; nothing was opened. Opening the session of a UMAC-protected project may wait on a Siemens logon dialog on the serve host that a human must answer (GATE G6: never invent credentials): a long wait answers status running, and a call that times out while the serve is alive returns a requires_human_action handoff. Returns {opened, alreadyOpen, session} with the session as in tia_local_sessions; its `handle` reaches the session's objects through tia_obj_*. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve: it runs the same checks and returns the plan or the same refusal WITHOUT changing anything. Nothing is ever checked in to the Project Server: check-in (CloseAndCommit) is not offered by any tool. Maps to POST /multiuser/localsessions/open {path}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

path.description: local session file path (.alsNN) on the serve host

name: tia_local_session_open
title: TIA — open a local session
